newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS FIRE COACH JOHNSTON, GM PATRICK TAKES OVER DUTIES.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS FIRE COACH JOHNSTON, GM PATRICK TAKES OVER DUTIES.

text.p: The Pittsburgh Penguins, losers of eight of their last nine games, fired head coach Eddie Johnston on Monday and said general manager Craig Patrick will take over as coach for the rest of the season.
The 60-year-old Johnson, serving in his second stint as Penguins coach since the 1993 season, will be reassigned to another position in the organisation, the NHL club said.
The Penguins have dropped four games in a row to fall nine points behind first-place Buffalo in the Northeast Division.
Pittsburgh is 31-26-5 and currently the fifth seed in the Eastern Conference, two points ahead of the New York Rangers.
